name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 8 visits over 55 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.3 days starting 2026-07-17, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
